PEANUT BUTTER
AND DARK CHOCOLATE CHIP MUFFINS GF
Made with rolled oats that you make into flour in your blender or food
processor (or oat flour that you purchase), this gluten-free recipe is also
low in FODMAPs (see chapter 9). That means, if you have trouble with gas,
bloating, and other digestive issues, this might be a good choice for you.
Even if you eat wheat and have no digestive issues, you'll enjoy this
yummy recipe from the blog For a Digestive Peace of Mind by Kate Scarlata,
RD, gut-health expert and author of The Low-FODMAP Diet Step By Step.
As Kate says, it is healthy-ish and can pass as either a muffin or a cupcake.
Kate makes this recipe in a blender and pours the batter into the muffin
